scripts.build:be: cd be && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: npm run codegen --silent && starci app lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm run codegen --silent && starci app lint --fix
scripts.test:integration: npm run typecheck:tests && cd be && jest --selectProjects integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run typecheck:tests && cd be && jest --selectProjects e2e
scripts.test:contract: npm run typecheck:tests && cd be && jest --selectProjects contract
